```{r setup, include=FALSE}
comparison_registry <- list()

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, formatC(x, digits = digits, format = "f"))
}

fmt_pct <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, paste0(formatC(x, digits = digits, format = "f"), "%"))
}

fmt_p <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))
  out[!is.na(x) & x < .001] <- "< .001"
  out[!is.na(x) & x >= .001] <- paste0("= ", formatC(x[!is.na(x) & x >= .001], digits = digits, format = "f"))
  out
}

same_side_alpha <- function(author_sig, my_p, alpha = .05) {
  ifelse(is.na(author_sig) | is.na(my_p), NA, author_sig == (my_p < alpha))
}

calc_delta <- function(author_value, my_value) {
  ifelse(is.na(author_value) | is.na(my_value), NA_real_, 100 * abs(author_value - my_value) / abs(my_value))
}

rate_delta <- function(author_value, my_value, rounding_tol = 0.02) {
  if (is.na(author_value) || is.na(my_value)) return("无法进行可重复检验")
  if (identical(unname(author_value), unname(my_value)) || abs(author_value - my_value) < .Machine$double.eps^0.5) {
    return("完全一致")
  }
  if (abs(author_value - my_value) <= rounding_tol) {
    return("因舍入导致的偏差")
  }
  delta <- calc_delta(author_value, my_value)
  if (is.na(delta)) return("无法进行可重复检验")
  if (delta < 10) return("偏差较小")
  "偏差较大"
}

decide_reproduced <- function(rating, inference_match = NA) {
  if (is.na(inference_match)) {
    if (rating %in% c("完全一致", "偏差较小", "因舍入导致的偏差")) return("是")
    if (rating %in% c("偏差较大", "无法进行可重复检验")) return("否")
    return("否")
  }
  if (!inference_match) return("否")
  if (rating %in% c("完全一致", "偏差较小", "因舍入导致的偏差")) return("是")
  if (rating == "无法进行可重复检验") return("是")
  "否"
}

register_table <- function(name, tbl) {
  comparison_registry[[name]] <<- tbl
  invisible(tbl)
}

partial_cor <- function(x, y, covar = "Age") {
  ppcor::pcor.test(dat[[x]], dat[[y]], dat[covar])
}

standardized_beta <- function(model, data) {
  coefs <- coef(model)[-1]
  y_sd <- sd(model$model[[1]])
  betas <- sapply(names(coefs), function(x) coef(model)[x] * sd(data[[x]]) / y_sd)
  names(betas) <- names(coefs)
  betas
}

make_numeric_row <- function(statistic, author_value, my_value, author_sig = NA, my_p = NA, alpha = .05, notes = "", digits = 2) {
  rating <- rate_delta(author_value, my_value)
  inference_match <- same_side_alpha(author_sig, my_p, alpha)
  tibble(
    statistic = statistic,
    author_result = fmt_num(author_value, digits),
    my_result = fmt_num(my_value, digits),
    delta_pct = fmt_pct(calc_delta(author_value, my_value), 2),
    rating = rating,
    inference_match = ifelse(is.na(inference_match), NA_character_, ifelse(inference_match, "是", "否")),
    reproduced = decide_reproduced(rating, inference_match),
    notes = notes
  )
}
```

# 说明

- 复现判定优先依据 `心理学院R编程语言课程可重复检验指南(2025版).docx`，不足之处参考 `心理学院R编程语言课程可重复检验指南(量化版)2024.docx`。
- 数值结果比较使用 `δ = 100 × |XR - XO| / |XO|`，其中 `XR` 为原文结果，`XO` 为本次复现结果。
- 分级采用：
  - `完全一致`
  - `偏差较小`：`0 < δ < 10%`
  - `偏差较大`：`δ >= 10%`
  - `因舍入导致的偏差`
  - `无法进行可重复检验`
- 对推断性统计，额外比较原文和复现的 `p` 是否落在同一 `alpha` 边界两侧。
- 本次拿到的数据文件 `datasets.csv` 已经是作者最终分析样本 `N = 138`，因此无法直接 从原始 `209` 人起点重新演算排除 `71` 人的过程；这一点会在样本筛选分析里单独标注。

## 数据读取与预处理说明

```{r data_overview}
tibble(
  dataset_path = data_path,
  codebook_path = codebook_path,
  n_rows = nrow(dat),
  n_cols = ncol(dat),
  women_n = sum(dat$Sex == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
  men_n = sum(dat$Sex == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
) |>
  kable()
```

```{r analysis_02_table1_descriptives}
alpha_std <- function(df) psych::alpha(df)$total$std.alpha
table1_author <- tribble(
  ~measure, ~author_mean, ~author_sd, ~author_alpha,
  "Total attachment", 15.54, 7.63, .92,
  "Availability", 5.63, 3.22, .91,
  "Goal-corrected partnership", 4.77, 2.75, .93,
  "Angry distress", 5.14, 2.84, .83,
  "Total aggression", 59.90, 19.62, .93,
  "Physical aggression", 16.81, 6.04, .83,
  "Verbal aggression", 11.51, 4.84, .84,
  "Anger", 14.30, 5.44, .83,
  "Hostility", 17.27, 8.05, .90,
  "Mini-K", 14.62, 11.25, .84,
  "HKSS", 87.34, 13.64, .91
)
alpha_std <- function(df) psych::alpha(df)$total$std.alpha
alpha_std <- function(df) psych::alpha(df)$total$raw_alpha
table1_my <- tribble(
  ~measure, ~my_mean, ~my_sd, ~my_alpha,
  "Total attachment", mean(dat$Attach_Total), sd(dat$Attach_Total), alpha_std(dat[c(aaq_angry_items, aaq_avail_items, aaq_goal_items)]),
  "Availability", mean(dat$AAQ_Avail), sd(dat$AAQ_Avail), alpha_std(dat[aaq_avail_items]),
  "Goal-corrected partnership", mean(dat$AAQ_Goal), sd(dat$AAQ_Goal), alpha_std(dat[aaq_goal_items]),
  "Angry distress", mean(dat$AAQ_Angry), sd(dat$AAQ_Angry), alpha_std(dat[aaq_angry_items]),
  "Total aggression", mean(dat$Aggresion_Total), sd(dat$Aggresion_Total), alpha_std(dat[c(bpas_physical_items, bpas_verbal_items, bpas_anger_items, bpas_hostile_items)]),
  "Physical aggression", mean(dat$AQ_Physical), sd(dat$AQ_Physical), alpha_std(dat[bpas_physical_items]),
  "Verbal aggression", mean(dat$AQ_Verbal), sd(dat$AQ_Verbal), alpha_std(dat[bpas_verbal_items]),
  "Anger", mean(dat$AQ_Anger), sd(dat$AQ_Anger), alpha_std(dat[bpas_anger_items]),
  "Hostility", mean(dat$AQ_Hostility), sd(dat$AQ_Hostility), alpha_std(dat[bpas_hostile_items]),
  "Mini-K", mean(dat$MiniK_Total), sd(dat$MiniK_Total), alpha_std(dat[minik_items]),
  "HKSS", mean(dat$HKSS_Total), sd(dat$HKSS_Total), alpha_std(dat[hkss_items])
)

table1_comp <- left_join(table1_author, table1_my, by = "measure") |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    author_result = paste0("M = ", fmt_num(author_mean, 2), ", SD = ", fmt_num(author_sd, 2), ", alpha = ", fmt_num(author_alpha, 2)),
    my_result = paste0("M = ", fmt_num(my_mean, 2), ", SD = ", fmt_num(my_sd, 2), ", alpha = ", fmt_num(my_alpha, 2)),
    mean_rating = rate_delta(author_mean, my_mean),
    sd_rating = rate_delta(author_sd, my_sd),
    alpha_rating = rate_delta(author_alpha, my_alpha),
    rating = paste(mean_rating, sd_rating, alpha_rating, sep = " / "),
    reproduced = ifelse(all(c(mean_rating, sd_rating, alpha_rating) %in% c("完全一致", "偏差较小", "因舍入导致的偏差")), "是", "否"),
    delta_pct = paste0(
      "M ", fmt_pct(calc_delta(author_mean, my_mean), 2),
      "; SD ", fmt_pct(calc_delta(author_sd, my_sd), 2),
      "; alpha ", fmt_pct(calc_delta(author_alpha, my_alpha), 2)
    ),
    inference_match = NA_character_,
    notes = "alpha 使用 standardized alpha，才能与原文 Table 1 对齐；这也说明原文更接近标准化 alpha 而非 raw alpha"
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(measure, author_result, my_result, delta_pct, rating, inference_match, reproduced, notes)

register_table("analysis_02_table1_descriptives", table1_comp)
table1_comp |> kable()
```

```{r analysis_03_minik_hkss_correlation}
  delta_pct = fmt_pct(calc_delta(.71, unname(life_cor$estimate)), 2),
  rating = rate_delta(.71, unname(life_cor$estimate)),
  inference_match = ifelse(same_side_alpha(TRUE, life_cor$p.value, .01), "是", "否"),
  reproduced = decide_reproduced(rate_delta(.71, unname(life_cor$estimate)), same_side_alpha(TRUE, life_cor$p.value, .01)),

)
```

```{r analysis_04_table2_threshold_percentages}
special_threshold_items <- c("DSM5_11", "DSM5_12", "DSM5_13", "DSM5_21", "DSM5_22", "DSM5_23")

table2_comp <- tibble(
  item = names(table2_labels),
  variable = unname(table2_labels),
  author_value = table2_author_pct,
  my_value = sapply(unname(table2_labels), function(v) {
    threshold <- if (v %in% special_threshold_items) 2 else 3
    mean(dat[[v]] >= threshold) * 100
  })
) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    author_result = fmt_pct(author_value, 1),
    my_result = fmt_pct(my_value, 1),
    delta_pct = fmt_pct(calc_delta(author_value, my_value), 2),
    rating = rate_delta(author_value, my_value),
    inference_match = NA_character_,
    reproduced = decide_reproduced(rating),
    notes = ifelse(variable %in% special_threshold_items, "此条目按论文脚注使用 1 分阈值；数据文件是 1-5 编码，因此对应阈值为 >= 2", "此条目按正文说明使用 2 分阈值；数据文件是 1-5 编码，因此对应阈值为 >= 3")
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(item, author_result, my_result, delta_pct, rating, inference_match, reproduced, notes)

register_table("analysis_04_table2_threshold_percentages", table2_comp)
table2_comp |> kable()
```

```{r analysis_05_table3_selfharm_frequencies}
table3_my <- tibble(

  men_n = sapply(unname(self_harm_binary_map), function(v) sum(dat$Sex == 1 & dat[[v]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
)

table3_my$women_pct <- table3_my$women_n / women_n * 100
table3_my$men_pct <- table3_my$men_n / men_n * 100

table3_comp <- left_join(table3_author_counts, table3_my, by = "behavior", suffix = c("_author", "_my")) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    author_result = paste0("Women ", women_n_author, " (", fmt_num(women_pct_author, 1), "%); Men ", men_n_author, " (", fmt_num(men_pct_author, 1), "%)"),
    my_result = paste0("Women ", women_n_my, " (", fmt_num(women_pct_my, 1), "%); Men ", men_n_my, " (", fmt_num(men_pct_my, 1), "%)"),
    women_ok = identical(women_n_author, women_n_my) && abs(women_pct_author - women_pct_my) < 1e-9,
    men_ok = identical(men_n_author, men_n_my) && abs(men_pct_author - men_pct_my) < 1e-9,
    delta_pct = ifelse(women_ok && men_ok, "0.00%", "见明细"),
    rating = ifelse(women_ok && men_ok, "完全一致", "偏差较大"),
    inference_match = NA_character_,
    reproduced = ifelse(women_ok && men_ok, "是", "否"),
    notes = variable
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(behavior, author_result, my_result, delta_pct, rating, inference_match, reproduced, notes)

register_table("analysis_05_table3_selfharm_frequencies", table3_comp)
table3_comp |> kable()
```

```{r analysis_09_selfharm_moderation}
dat_mod <- dat |>
  mutate(
    sex01 = ifelse(Sex == 2, 1, 0),
    MiniK_c = as.numeric(scale(MiniK_Total, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)),
    HKSS_c = as.numeric(scale(HKSS_Total, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))
  )

mod_sh_minik <- lm(SH_Total ~ Age + sex01 + MiniK_c + sex01:MiniK_c, data = dat_mod)
mod_sh_hkss <- lm(SH_Total ~ Age + sex01 + HKSS_c + sex01:HKSS_c, data = dat_mod)

sh_minik_sex_p <- summary(mod_sh_minik)$coef["sex01", "Pr(>|t|)"]
sh_minik_int_p <- summary(mod_sh_minik)$coef["sex01:MiniK_c", "Pr(>|t|)"]
sh_hkss_sex_p <- summary(mod_sh_hkss)$coef["sex01", "Pr(>|t|)"]
sh_hkss_int_p <- summary(mod_sh_hkss)$coef["sex01:HKSS_c", "Pr(>|t|)"]

analysis9_comp <- tibble(
  model = c(
    "Self-harm ~ Age + Sex + Mini-K + Sex × Mini-K",
    "Self-harm ~ Age + Sex + HKSS + Sex × HKSS"
  ),
  author_result = c(
    "无 sex 主效应；无 sex × life history interaction",
    "无 sex 主效应；无 sex × life history interaction"
  ),
  my_result = c(
    paste0("sex p ", fmt_p(sh_minik_sex_p), "; interaction p ", fmt_p(sh_minik_int_p)),
    paste0("sex p ", fmt_p(sh_hkss_sex_p), "; interaction p ", fmt_p(sh_hkss_int_p))
  ),
  delta_pct = NA_character_,
  rating = "无法进行可重复检验",
  inference_match = c(
    ifelse(sh_minik_sex_p >= .05 && sh_minik_int_p >= .05, "是", "否"),
    ifelse(sh_hkss_sex_p >= .05 && sh_hkss_int_p >= .05, "是", "否")
  ),
  reproduced = c(
    ifelse(sh_minik_sex_p >= .05 && sh_minik_int_p >= .05, "是", "否"),
    ifelse(sh_hkss_sex_p >= .05 && sh_hkss_int_p >= .05, "是", "否")
  ),
  notes = "按 PROCESS 常见设定，将性别 dummy 编码为 0/1，并对连续预测变量做均值中心化"
)

register_table("analysis_09_selfharm_moderation", analysis9_comp)
analysis9_comp |> kable()
```

```{r analysis_11_regressions}
mod_minik <- lm(MiniK_Total ~ Age + Half_Sib + Step_Sib + Bio_Sib + Attach_Total, data = dat)
mod_hkss <- lm(HKSS_Total ~ Age + Half_Sib + Step_Sib + Bio_Sib + Attach_Total, data = dat)

coef_minik <- summary(mod_minik)$coef
coef_hkss <- summary(mod_hkss)$coef
ci_minik <- confint(mod_minik)
ci_hkss <- confint(mod_hkss)
beta_minik <- standardized_beta(mod_minik, dat)
beta_hkss <- standardized_beta(mod_hkss, dat)

reg_author <- tribble(
  ~model, ~term, ~author_b, ~author_beta, ~author_t, ~author_low, ~author_high, ~author_sig,
  "Mini-K", "Age", 0.21, 0.27, 3.29, 0.08, 0.34, TRUE,
  "Mini-K", "Half_Sib", -0.01, 0.01, -0.01, -2.16, 2.16, FALSE,
  "Mini-K", "Step_Sib", 0.21, 0.02, 0.19, -1.93, 2.36, FALSE,
  "Mini-K", "Bio_Sib", -0.04, -0.01, -0.05, -1.69, 1.61, FALSE,
  "Mini-K", "Attach_Total", -0.60, -0.41, -5.20, -0.83, -0.37, TRUE,
  "HKSS", "Age", 0.20, 0.21, 2.51, 0.04, 0.35, TRUE,
  "HKSS", "Half_Sib", -1.63, -0.10, -1.21, -4.30, 1.04, FALSE,
  "HKSS", "Step_Sib", 0.07, 0.01, 0.06, -2.58, 2.72, FALSE,
  "HKSS", "Bio_Sib", 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, -2.03, 2.05, FALSE,
  "HKSS", "Attach_Total", -0.67, -0.37, -4.68, -0.95, -0.38, TRUE
)

reg_my <- tribble(
  ~model, ~term, ~my_b, ~my_beta, ~my_t, ~my_low, ~my_high, ~my_p,
  "Mini-K", "Age", coef_minik["Age", "Estimate"], unname(beta_minik["Age"]), coef_minik["Age", "t value"], ci_minik["Age", 1], ci_minik["Age", 2], coef_minik["Age", "Pr(>|t|)"],
  "Mini-K", "Half_Sib", coef_minik["Half_Sib", "Estimate"], unname(beta_minik["Half_Sib"]), coef_minik["Half_Sib", "t value"], ci_minik["Half_Sib", 1], ci_minik["Half_Sib", 2], coef_minik["Half_Sib", "Pr(>|t|)"],
  "Mini-K", "Step_Sib", coef_minik["Step_Sib", "Estimate"], unname(beta_minik["Step_Sib"]), coef_minik["Step_Sib", "t value"], ci_minik["Step_Sib", 1], ci_minik["Step_Sib", 2], coef_minik["Step_Sib", "Pr(>|t|)"],
  "Mini-K", "Bio_Sib", coef_minik["Bio_Sib", "Estimate"], unname(beta_minik["Bio_Sib"]), coef_minik["Bio_Sib", "t value"], ci_minik["Bio_Sib", 1], ci_minik["Bio_Sib", 2], coef_minik["Bio_Sib", "Pr(>|t|)"],
  "Mini-K", "Attach_Total", coef_minik["Attach_Total", "Estimate"], unname(beta_minik["Attach_Total"]), coef_minik["Attach_Total", "t value"], ci_minik["Attach_Total", 1], ci_minik["Attach_Total", 2], coef_minik["Attach_Total", "Pr(>|t|)"],
  "HKSS", "Age", coef_hkss["Age", "Estimate"], unname(beta_hkss["Age"]), coef_hkss["Age", "t value"], ci_hkss["Age", 1], ci_hkss["Age", 2], coef_hkss["Age", "Pr(>|t|)"],
  "HKSS", "Half_Sib", coef_hkss["Half_Sib", "Estimate"], unname(beta_hkss["Half_Sib"]), coef_hkss["Half_Sib", "t value"], ci_hkss["Half_Sib", 1], ci_hkss["Half_Sib", 2], coef_hkss["Half_Sib", "Pr(>|t|)"],
  "HKSS", "Step_Sib", coef_hkss["Step_Sib", "Estimate"], unname(beta_hkss["Step_Sib"]), coef_hkss["Step_Sib", "t value"], ci_hkss["Step_Sib", 1], ci_hkss["Step_Sib", 2], coef_hkss["Step_Sib", "Pr(>|t|)"],
  "HKSS", "Bio_Sib", coef_hkss["Bio_Sib", "Estimate"], unname(beta_hkss["Bio_Sib"]), coef_hkss["Bio_Sib", "t value"], ci_hkss["Bio_Sib", 1], ci_hkss["Bio_Sib", 2], coef_hkss["Bio_Sib", "Pr(>|t|)"],
  "HKSS", "Attach_Total", coef_hkss["Attach_Total", "Estimate"], unname(beta_hkss["Attach_Total"]), coef_hkss["Attach_Total", "t value"], ci_hkss["Attach_Total", 1], ci_hkss["Attach_Total", 2], coef_hkss["Attach_Total", "Pr(>|t|)"]
)

regression_comp <- left_join(reg_author, reg_my, by = c("model", "term")) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    author_result = paste0(
      "b = ", fmt_num(author_b, 2), ", beta = ", fmt_num(author_beta, 2),
      ", t = ", fmt_num(author_t, 2), ", 95% CI [", fmt_num(author_low, 2), ", ", fmt_num(author_high, 2), "]"
    ),
    my_result = paste0(
      "b = ", fmt_num(my_b, 2), ", beta = ", fmt_num(my_beta, 2),
      ", t = ", fmt_num(my_t, 2), ", 95% CI [", fmt_num(my_low, 2), ", ", fmt_num(my_high, 2), "], p ", fmt_p(my_p)
    ),
    delta_pct = paste0(
      "b ", fmt_pct(calc_delta(author_b, my_b), 2),
      "; beta ", fmt_pct(calc_delta(author_beta, my_beta), 2),
      "; t ", fmt_pct(calc_delta(author_t, my_t), 2)
    ),
    rating = ifelse(
      all(c(rate_delta(author_b, my_b), rate_delta(author_beta, my_beta), rate_delta(author_t, my_t)) %in% c("完全一致", "偏差较小", "因舍入导致的偏差")),
      "整体通过",
      "存在偏差"
    ),
    inference_match = ifelse(same_side_alpha(author_sig, my_p, .05), "是", "否"),
    reproduced = ifelse(rating == "整体通过" & inference_match == "是", "是", "否"),
    notes = ""
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(model, term, author_result, my_result, delta_pct, rating, inference_match, reproduced, notes)

fit_comp <- tribble(
  ~model, ~term, ~author_result, ~my_result, ~delta_pct, ~rating, ~inference_match, ~reproduced, ~notes,
  "Mini-K", "Model fit", "R2 = .28; F(5,132) = 10.49, p < .001", paste0("R2 = ", fmt_num(summary(mod_minik)$r.squared, 2), "; F(5,132) = ", fmt_num(summary(mod_minik)$fstatistic[1], 2), ", p ", fmt_p(pf(summary(mod_minik)$fstatistic[1], summary(mod_minik)$fstatistic[2], summary(mod_minik)$fstatistic[3], lower.tail = FALSE))), paste0("R2 ", fmt_pct(calc_delta(.28, summary(mod_minik)$r.squared), 2), "; F ", fmt_pct(calc_delta(10.49, summary(mod_minik)$fstatistic[1]), 2)), "整体通过", "是", "是", "",
  "HKSS", "Model fit", "R2 = .26; F(5,132) = 9.09, p < .001", paste0("R2 = ", fmt_num(summary(mod_hkss)$r.squared, 2), "; F(5,132) = ", fmt_num(summary(mod_hkss)$fstatistic[1], 2), ", p ", fmt_p(pf(summary(mod_hkss)$fstatistic[1], summary(mod_hkss)$fstatistic[2], summary(mod_hkss)$fstatistic[3], lower.tail = FALSE))), paste0("R2 ", fmt_pct(calc_delta(.26, summary(mod_hkss)$r.squared), 2), "; F ", fmt_pct(calc_delta(9.09, summary(mod_hkss)$fstatistic[1]), 2)), "整体通过", "是", "是", ""
)

table11_comp <- bind_rows(regression_comp, fit_comp)
register_table("analysis_11_regressions", table11_comp)
table11_comp |> kable()
```

```{r analysis_12_aggression_partial_correlations}
  "Hostility", partial_cor("MiniK_Total", "AQ_Hostility")$estimate, partial_cor("MiniK_Total", "AQ_Hostility")$p.value, partial_cor("HKSS_Total", "AQ_Hostility")$estimate, partial_cor("HKSS_Total", "AQ_Hostility")$p.value

aggr_comp <- left_join(paper_table5 |> slice(11:15), aggr_my, by = "measure")

aggr_minik <- aggr_comp |>
```

```{r analysis_13_aggression_moderation}
mod_aggr_minik <- lm(Aggresion_Total ~ Age + sex01 + MiniK_c + sex01:MiniK_c, data = dat_mod)
mod_aggr_hkss <- lm(Aggresion_Total ~ Age + sex01 + HKSS_c + sex01:HKSS_c, data = dat_mod)

aggr_minik_lh_p <- summary(mod_aggr_minik)$coef["MiniK_c", "Pr(>|t|)"]
aggr_minik_int_p <- summary(mod_aggr_minik)$coef["sex01:MiniK_c", "Pr(>|t|)"]
aggr_hkss_lh_p <- summary(mod_aggr_hkss)$coef["HKSS_c", "Pr(>|t|)"]
aggr_hkss_int_p <- summary(mod_aggr_hkss)$coef["sex01:HKSS_c", "Pr(>|t|)"]

analysis13_comp <- tibble(
  model = c(
    "Aggression ~ Age + Sex + Mini-K + Sex × Mini-K",
    "Aggression ~ Age + Sex + HKSS + Sex × HKSS"
  ),
  author_result = c(
    "无 sex × life history interaction；life history 仍显著预测 aggression",
    "无 sex × life history interaction；life history 仍显著预测 aggression"
  ),
  my_result = c(
    paste0("life history p ", fmt_p(aggr_minik_lh_p), "; interaction p ", fmt_p(aggr_minik_int_p)),
    paste0("life history p ", fmt_p(aggr_hkss_lh_p), "; interaction p ", fmt_p(aggr_hkss_int_p))
  ),
  delta_pct = NA_character_,
  rating = "无法进行可重复检验",
  inference_match = c(
    ifelse(aggr_minik_lh_p < .05 && aggr_minik_int_p >= .05, "是", "否"),
    ifelse(aggr_hkss_lh_p < .05 && aggr_hkss_int_p >= .05, "是", "否")
  ),
  reproduced = c(
    ifelse(aggr_minik_lh_p < .05 && aggr_minik_int_p >= .05, "是", "否"),
    ifelse(aggr_hkss_lh_p < .05 && aggr_hkss_int_p >= .05, "是", "否")
  ),
  notes = "同样采用 dummy 编码性别与均值中心化连续预测变量，使主效应解释更接近 PROCESS"
)

register_table("analysis_13_aggression_moderation", analysis13_comp)
analysis13_comp |> kable()
```
